# QuantumSafeMigration.com

> QuantumSafeMigration.com - possible vendor-neutral banner for quantum-safe migration, also referred to as post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration: timelines, framework, operating model and public sources.

No affiliation with public authorities, regulators, standards bodies or vendors. Descriptive use only. No legal, financial, medical, regulatory or investment advice. No security or tax advice. Descriptive digital asset only: no service, no platform, no certification. Domain name only is transferred. No software, datasets, services or staff included.
